places.name: Gipson Play Plaza at Dix Park
places.note: Free; free parking. Big destination playground on the south edge of Dix Park.

places.name: Museum of Life and Science
places.note: Tickets: $24 adults, $19 ages 3–15, under 3 free. Hideaway Woods treehouses and creek, farmyard, train ride and Dinosaur Trail are outside.

places.name: Hill Ridge Farms
places.note: Fall festival: tickets at the gate, each with a free pumpkin. Last admission an hour before closing; less busy Wednesday to Friday.

places.name: Phillips Farms of Cary
places.address: 6701 Good Hope Church Rd, Cary, NC 27519
places.note: Fall family fun park: tickets at the gate.

places.name: Sarah P. Duke Gardens
places.note: Free; paid parking that often fills before 10 a.m. on nice days. Five miles of paths, and the Charlotte Brody Discovery Garden.

places.name: NC Botanical Garden
places.address: 100 Old Mason Farm Rd, Chapel Hill, NC 27517
places.note: Free. Display gardens, and nature trails through the forest behind them.

places.name: JC Raulston Arboretum
places.note: Free. NC State’s garden; no pets.

places.name: NC Museum of Art Museum Park
places.note: Free. 164 acres of trails, lawns and big outdoor art; the Capital Area Greenway runs through.

places.name: Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve
places.note: Free. About three miles of mulched trails and boardwalks with stairs (a carrier beats a stroller); restrooms in the Stevens Nature Center, open Mon–Sat 10–5, Sun 1–5.

places.name: Raleigh Rose Garden
places.note: Free. A small terraced rose garden behind Raleigh Little Theatre, good for a short walk; no public restrooms, parking on Pogue Street.
